items.p: कंपनी के सितंबर तिमाही के शानदार नतीजे सामने आने के बाद शेयर में इंट्राडे कारोबार के दौरान करीब 8 फीसदी की तेजी आई। इसके साथ ही कंपनी ने निवेशकों के लिए 100 फीसदी अंतरिम डिविडेंड और 2:1 बोनस शेयर देने का भी ऐलान किया है।

items.h: FD पर 8.60% तक ब्याज! नवंबर में इन 5 बैंकों ने बदलीं दरें, यहां मिलेगा सबसे ज्यादा रिटर्न
items.p: नवंबर 2026 में कई बैंकों ने FD की ब्याज दरों में बदलाव किया है। सूर्योदय स्मॉल फाइनेंस बैंक वरिष्ठ नागरिक को 5 साल की FD पर 8.60% तक ब्याज दे रहा है, जबकि सामान्य ग्राहकों के लिए अधिकतम दर 8.25% है। उत्कर्ष SFB में 666 दिन की FD पर सीनियर सिटीजन को 8.50% तक रिटर्न मिल रहा है।

items.p: विश्व स्वर्ण परिषद (डब्ल्यूजीसी) की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, 2026 की तीसरी तिमाही में सोने की वैश्विक मांग 1% घटी। ऊंची कीमतों के कारण आभूषणों की मांग में 17% की बड़ी गिरावट दर्ज की गई, जबकि गोल्ड ईटीएफ और केंद्रीय बैंकों की खरीद बढ़ी।

items.p: The World Bank says India lifted an estimated 496 million people out of poverty between 2011 and 2023. Extreme poverty fell from 27.1% to 2.6%, driven by consumption growth, rising employment—particularly among women—and expanded social transfers.

items.p: The panel will review India's banking sector and recommend structural, institutional, regulatory and legislative reforms to make it globally competitive, financially inclusive and resilient by 2047.

items.h: Extreme poverty in India falls to 2.6% from 27.1%: World Bank
items.p: As many as 496 million people moved above the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day between 2011 and 2023, according to the World Bank’s October 2026 Poverty & Equity Brief.

items.h: ‘2026 resembles 1991’: Why CEA V Anantha Nageswaran wants India to rethink its growth strategy — what he said
items.p: India must rethink its growth strategy as global tensions and supply-chain shocks threaten access to critical resources, Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran warned. He urged stronger domestic capabilities, diversified imports and strategic buffers.

items.p: West Asia conflict has pushed working-capital demand at Indian banks up 15-20% as rising raw-material costs and shipping delays squeeze corporate cash flows. The surge has added to loan growth in the September quarter, with lenders also benefiting from refinancing and acquisition

items.h: RBI proposes  ₹100-crore priority sector lending limit for agri infra, food processing
items.p: Under the draft rules, loans for agriculture infrastructure will be eligible for PSL classification subject to an aggregate sanctioned limit of  ₹100 crore per borrower across the banking system. A similar limit has been proposed for food and agro-processing activities.

items.h: LIC seeks alignment with global standards, EoM glide path in feedback to Irdai’s distribution proposals
items.p: LIC has asked Irdai for global-style caps on distribution costs and more time to meet them, while saying it backs the push for lower costs. Its quarterly profit rose 20.1%, and it doesn’t expect the IDBI Bank stake sale to hurt its bank sales much.

items.h: Trai proposes framework for satellite-to-phone services
items.p: The new framework will allow satellite companies to provide network infrastructure and capacity to telecom operators. It would allow telcos, satellite communication providers to expand their offerings and tap new revenue streams, once permitted.

items.h: Gaur Chowk underpass opens for trial: Will Greater Noida commuters finally get relief from traffic jams?
items.p: The successful completion of the trial run is expected to pave the way for the underpass's formal opening, potentially bringing relief to residents of Greater Noida West and daily commuters travelling through the junction.

items.h: Govt bond yields retreat from day’s lows on profit booking; rupee ends up
items.p: India’s 10-year bond yield rebounded from an early low to close at 7.17% as banks likely booked profits and traders waited for Friday’s big auction.

items.h: India’s  ₹1.31 lakh crore railway project could break China’s record with world’s highest station in Ladakh | Details
items.p: India is planning a  ₹1.31 lakh crore railway corridor connecting Bilaspur in Himachal Pradesh to Leh in Ladakh. Spanning 489 km, the proposed line could feature the world's highest railway station at 17,244 feet and include 270 km of tunnels.

items.h: Post offices to serve as dark stores as govt expands Gujarat farmer e-commerce model to other states
items.p: After rollouts in Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh, the agriculture ministry and India Post are collaborating to take the farmer e-commerce model to Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra.

items.h: Can TV serial characters turn viewers into shoppers?
items.p: Dangal TV and Flipkart are testing content-to-commerce through Hindi drama Rimjhim, integrating products into storylines. Experts see potential among Hindi-heartland audiences, but say purchases depend on easy mobile checkout, compelling integration and reliable measurement.

items.h: TRAI's new Network Anubhav platform to map real-world network speeds, call quality
items.p: TRAI launched the Network Anubhav Platform, a geospatial dashboard combining anonymised user tests and regulator drive tests to help consumers compare mobile and broadband performance by location. It also gives telecom providers data to identify network issues.

items.h: How banks are preparing for India's new credit risk era
items.p: Banks like SBI, HDFC and others are proactively frontloading financial provisions ahead of the upcoming ‘expected credit loss’ regime to absorb the initial balance-sheet hit and smooth out recurring costs.

items.h: India’s green aviation push comes with a fuel bill: SAF mandate to hit airlines
items.p: The draft policy would put 1% green fuel in jet fuel from 2027, rising to 5% by 2030. The fuel costs two to three times more, so analysts expect a small initial hit that grows as targets rise.

items.h: India plans to allow recycled plastic for food packaging
items.p: India plans to widen the use of recycled plastic in food packaging, helping food delivery platforms and consumer goods companies meet recycling targets. The proposal has strict caveats on safety standards, as the regulator seeks to balance sustainability with the risk of food con

items.h: Jio launches  ₹15 unlimited 5G data pack: Get 24 hours of high-speed internet; check benefits, validity
items.p: The pack is designed to provide short-term access to high-speed mobile internet without requiring users to purchase a more expensive data plan

items.h: Diwali gift for MMR commuters as Metro 5, 5A tenders issued; new corridors to connect Bhiwandi, Kalyan, Ulhasnagar soon
items.p: In Kalyan, KDMC mayor Harshali Chaudhari-Thavil and Shiv Sena city president Ravi Patil welcomed the move, acknowledging the efforts of Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde and Kalyan MP Dr Shrikant Shinde in advancing the project.

items.h: Decoded: Why India’s $130 billion pharma ambition faces a hurdle as investigation backlogs delay drug batch releases
items.p: A Vector Consulting Group study finds that 80% of surveyed pharmaceutical manufacturing professionals reported batch-release delays due to open investigations, highlighting how incident backlogs, documentation requirements and supervisory constraints can affect factory productivi

items.h: Bengaluru bus fares hiked: Old vs new ticket prices - How much more will you pay for BMTC from Wednesday midnight?
items.p: The maximum fare for Vayu Vajra buses operating between Bengaluru and the airport has also been increased from  ₹405 to  ₹425.

items.h: Govt proposes immediate licence suspension for substandard drug makers
items.p: Draft amendments to India’s Drugs Rules would allow licensing authorities to immediately suspend manufacturers after a government analyst finds a medicine fails critical quality standards.

items.h: Tests underway for 15% isobutanol blend in diesel: Gadkari
items.p: The move is part of the government's push to promote biofuels, reduce dependence on imported crude oil and check vehicular emissions.

items.h: Hanuman Ansh co-producer Anupriya Nagar’s Mumbai home is a treasure trove of art and collectibles | Take a tour
items.p: Anupriya Nagar is the co-producer of 2026's blockbuster film, Hanuman Ansh.

items.h: Inside Virat Kohli’s  ₹80-crore Gurugram bungalow: 10,000 sq ft, hanging pool and geometric interiors
items.p: Virat Kohli’s 10,000 sq ft bungalow in Gurugram’s DLF City Phase 1 is reportedly valued at  ₹80 crore. The property features a hanging swimming pool, a dedicated gym, expansive balconies and contemporary interiors.

items.h: Yeshwantpur Goa Vande Bharat duration: 54 kmph average speed makes it slower than superfast trains
items.p: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express is expected to be flagged off this month. It will be running between Yeshwantpur and Madgaon.

items.h: GCCs power office Reit leasing as IT demand cools
items.p: The increased leasing by GCCs comes at a time when demand from IT services firms, once the largest office occupiers, has shrunk.

items.h: DLF to launch next phase of Mumbai's The Westpark in November, prices start at  ₹6.9 crore – All you need to know
items.p: After  ₹2,300 crore sellout, DLF will be launching the second phase of his debut project in Mumbai, The Westpark. The upcoming phase will see 135 residences across two towers.

items.h: Mint Explainer: Will IBBI’s new rules speed up relief for stranded homebuyers?
items.p: By allowing viable housing projects to be separated from a developer's overall debt, the 30 October IBBI amendments aim to fast-track handovers and safeguard buyers who haven't filed formal claims.

items.h: Faster clearances, land reforms, job-linked incentives — Expectations high from Bengal's proposed new industrial policy
items.p: Industry leaders want West Bengal’s proposed new industrial policy to deliver faster clearances, transparent land allocation, reliable infrastructure and incentives tied to job creation. Here's all we know.

items.h: Who is Vishal Mishra? Report reveals details of  ₹22 crore worth of property Toxic composer bought in Mumbai's Andheri
items.p: Singer and composer Vishal Mishra has reportedly purchased four residential apartments measuring in Mumbai's Andheri for a total of  ₹22.25 crore, according to a report.

items.h: RBI sets up market advisory panel to address liquidity, resilience concerns
items.p: The committee, comprising senior bankers, market infrastructure executives and industry representatives, will advise on policy and operational issues across money, bond and foreign exchange markets.

items.h: India’s first indigenous bullet train takes shape at Bengaluru's BEML - what is Bharat Train Control System?
items.p: At BEML’s Bengaluru plant, Ashwini Vaishnaw inspected key manufacturing stages and quality tests for India’s bullet train. The 202-metre, eight-coach train is designed to operate at 249 kmph. It is also planned to use the indigenous Bharat Train Control System.

items.h: Beyond brand deals: creators find a new revenue stream in paid advice
items.p: From career advice to marketing and communication coaching, content creators are charging followers for personalised expertise. Paid consultations are emerging as an additional income stream as creators seek greater control over earnings beyond brand partnerships.

items.h: Ramayana set to lead biggest Diwali box office on record
items.p: Star power across markets, record pre-Diwali advance bookings, and IMAX sell-outs are driving expectations for a festive revival after years of underperforming holiday weekends.

items.h: RBI's proposed curbs on revolving credit push NBFCs back to the drawing board
items.p: Bajaj Finance and Tata Capital are testing alternative loan structures to protect MSME and small-business lending as the central bank signals little willingness to relax its proposed restrictions.

items.h: India plans  ₹8,000-cr outlay to boost khadi, handloom and handicraft output
items.p: The latest push assumes importance because new trade deals have opened doors abroad, but exports of handloom and handicrafts may not take off in a big way unless Indian businesses improve competitiveness, build scale and connect better to overseas markets

items.h: Oil slips after early surge as US-Iran tensions persist, Brent falls 3%
items.p: The volatility poses a concern for India as it imports about 90% of its overall crude oil requirements. The import bill in the last fiscal year stood at around $123 billion.

items.h: SBI eyes margin boost from rate hikes, but wary of consumption credit hit
items.p: Speaking at the State Bank of India’s September quarter earnings press conference, chairman Setty said government bond yields were already factoring in one more rate hike, suggesting that much of the likely rate movement was already priced in

items.h: Who is Rajendra Lodha? Former Lodha Developers director faces fresh FIR over alleged  ₹6.67 crore Mumbai flat fraud
items.p: The latest complaint, filed by Lodha Developers, accuses Lodha and five others of manipulating a property transaction dating back to 2019 and causing substantial financial losses to the company.

items.h: Economy can sustain high-growth trajectory in FY27, recent GST reforms to help: Finmin review
items.p: However, there are still considerable global uncertainties, including elevated oil prices and inflation, that warrant constant vigilance, said the department of economic affairs in its October review.

items.p: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang identified 3 countries as world’s leading nations in manufacturing & advanced technology, excluding India. He said China’s strength comes from combining industrial production with computer science, after the US shifted much of its heavy manufacturing t

items.h: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
items.p: India is the only emerging market economy among nine with GDP above $1 trillion projected to reduce its public debt ratio between 2025 and 2031, with the ratio expected to fall from 84.3% of GDP in FY26 to 75.1% in FY32, RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said.

items.h: Industrial output growth a tad slower at 6.7% in September, expansion led by manufacturing, electricity generation
items.p: The industrial output growth moderated to 6.7% in September from 8% in August, driven by strong performances in manufacturing and electricity generation despite a drop in mining.

items.h: Cabinet approves PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana for 2026-31 with  ₹7,395 crore outlay to strengthen Panchayat governance
items.p: The Union Cabinet has approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana for 2026-27 to 2030-31, with an outlay of  ₹7,395.55 crore. The scheme will cover over 2.55 lakh Panchayats and traditional local bodies, benefiting around 32 lakh elected representatives and functionarie

items.h: ICICI MF का हाउसिंग अपॉर्च्युनिटी फंड खुला, जानिए क्या आपको इनवेस्ट करना चाहिए?
items.p: हाउसिंग अपॉरचुनिटीज फंड का बेंचमार्क निफ्टी हाउसिंग इंडेक्स होगा। यह एनएसई का हाल में लॉन्च इंडेक्स है। यह फंड न सिर्फ रियल एस्टेट कंपनियों के शेयरों में निवेश करेगा बल्कि रियल एस्टेट सेक्टर से जुड़ी दूसरी कंपनियों में भी इनवेस्ट करेगा

items.p: कंपनी का फॉलो-ऑन पब्लिक ऑफर (FPO) गुरुवार (24 मार्च) को खुल गया है। इसमें 28 मार्च तक इनवेस्ट किया जा सकता है। कंपनी ने प्रति शेयर 615 से 650 रुपये का प्राइस बैंड तय किया है

items.h: शेयरों पर फिदा इंडियन इनवेस्टर्स, पहले कभी नहीं किया था इतना इनवेस्ट

items.h: Share Market Updates: मल्टीप्लेक्स शेयरों पर चला RRR का जादू, PVR और INOX के शेयर 7% तक चढ़े
